purpose: Define which panels belong to Author, Player, and Dev Mode to reduce cross-over and duplication.
consolidationRules: Timeline/source review is Author Mode only by default.
Player Mode should not show the raw draft timeline browser.
Dev Mode uses validation summaries and project library rather than duplicating Author source review.
1788 decision queue belongs to Author Mode.
Project Library is visible to Author and Dev only.
Player character HUD and route node state replace generic timeline browsing in Player Mode.
Author Mode should use sub-workspace navigation so narrative/worldbuilding, source review, timelines, and decisions are not all competing at once.
V10 fixes mode visibility by explicitly hiding all author-only panels outside Author Mode.
Canon Promotion Queue is visible in Author Mode only and remains non-operative until a future controlled promotion workflow is implemented.
V11 updates visibility logic to set both class and hidden attributes, fixing missing Player/Dev panels caused by static hidden attributes in HTML.
V12 adds route-state and author-section detail workspaces while retaining strict per-mode panel visibility.
V13 fixes missing canon queue runtime functions and adds route-state test fixture panel in Dev Mode.
V14 adds a runtime contract panel and restores V9 author workspace functions that had drifted out of app.js.
